newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Norilsk falls after share transfer.
newsitem.headline: Russia Norilsk falls after share transfer.

text.p: Shares in Russian metals producer Norilsk Nickel dropped to $4.650 at 0915 GMT on Thursday from $5.400 at the close on Wednesday in an otherwise calm market.
It was the fifth most traded share by dollar volume on the Russian Trading System.

Norilsk said it had transferred 10 percent of equity, or over 12.5 million shares, held in a special fund intended for employees, had been transferred to employees, 1.5 million for free and the rest at less than $1.00 per share.
Workers had the right to sell the shares, transferred from government holdings, from April 8, it said.
A Western analyst who said the company needs restructuring and has lost government support was not surprised by the drop.
"It should have plummeted some time ago," he said.
